card.name: The word of after inhibitor or inducer
card.fires_on: The word "of" (occasionally "the") right after "inhibitor(s)" or "inducer", usually preceded by strong, moderate, weak or potent. It appears in drug interaction text before an enzyme such as CYP3A.
